main_text.l: 18. An in uno loco notatus; alibi censeatur no-tatus?
19. An si alicui interdictum vel arte vel ne-gotiatione, vel loco, id alibi locum habeat?
20. An Tabellio extra suum territorium recte conficiat instrumentum?
1. Utrum Princeps statuta condat super iis, que jure divino sunt introducta?
2. Utrum recte statuta condat de negotiis mere ecclesiasticis?
3. An Statuto fiat licitum, quod aliter in conscientia est illicitum?
4. An Statuta recte condantur circa ea que spectant jus naturale, & gentium primævum?
5. An statutum valeat super negotiis, de quibus abunde jure civili cautum est?
6. An statuta valeant, que condita contra jus civile?
1. Num valeat statutum, ne cum peregrino matrimonium contrahatur?
2. Ne filie nobilium civice conditionis viris nubant?

page.notes: The "R 4" at the foot is the gathering signature. "3. Ne" at the foot right is the catchword, marked as printed. The "1" in "1. Utrum" is a large initial U with no separate printed word. The scan is faint in places; the readings above are my best reading of the printed letters, and the text of the questions is copied from the print without correction.
